name: Wicket
brief: Generic JSON RPC over Business Central — eighteen operations for LLM agents
description: Wicket exposes eighteen generic operations through a single API page: discover/describe/query/readBlob for reading, insert/modify/delete for writing, invoke and the named-action catalog for running enrolled business logic, status/cancel/requests for asynchronous delivery of large queries to Azure Blob Storage, and capabilities/skill/pageUrl/whoAmI for self-description. Deny-by-default table exposure and field-level policy, RFC 7807 problems, optimistic concurrency, idempotent writes, App Insights telemetry, and full operation logging. Designed for LLM agents.
